subject_definitions:
沐小葵 is the user-identified Phantom Blade Zero sword fighter from the character sheet. Preserve her game-CG face, long dark half-up hair, anatomical left-temple gold ornament, red-and-gold ribbons, teal collar, black scarf and cape, engraved bronze armor and brown-red sleeves. Retain reference proportions and materials.

summary:
Create a six-second, 16:9 wuxia entrance in an empty ancient Chinese courtyard: worn paving, red pillars, gray tiled roofs and afternoon light. One low forward leap leads to preparation and one left-handed diagonal slash. Slow motion and her Chinese name start together at three seconds, followed by a guard.

retention_analysis:
Use <Picture1> as the sole character identity reference. Extract one heroine and discard sheet panels, borders, labels and repeated views. Preserve one sword: a blunt gold rear pommel and its round gold flange, a short handle fully enclosed by her anatomical LEFT hand, the forward guard and ONE continuous long black blade ending in one sharp tip. The rear flange belongs to the blunt pommel, not the guard; no blade extends from that end. Her RIGHT hand remains empty and separate. The only lettering is exactly "沐小葵". 画面姓名只写三个字：沐小葵。Do not show English, pinyin, logos or other labels.

detailed_description:
0-2 seconds, ordinary speed: Open at chest height with her whole body visible slightly right of center through the gate, leaving frame left clear. She makes one low forward leap, head upright and sword clear of her limbs. She lands feet first once, knees absorbing the landing. The left grip stays closed; the empty right arm balances her. No flip or repeated jump.

2-3 seconds, ordinary speed: Settle into a three-quarter stance and prepare one diagonal slash. Show the blunt rear pommel, closed left grip, front guard and single black blade as a connected structure. Thumb and fingers enclose the short handle. Cape and ribbons follow naturally. Begin one smooth thirty-degree front orbit, without cuts or inverted views.

3-5 seconds: At exactly three seconds, simultaneously begin slow motion and reveal the COMPLETE Chinese name "沐小葵", all three finished glyphs together. Place a clear vertical column at frame LEFT: top 沐, middle 小, bottom 葵. 画面左侧竖排“沐”“小”“葵”，每字完整清楚。 Use large elegant ivory Chinese brush lettering with antique-gold edging, within x=10-28 percent and y=18-82 percent. Keep her body right of center at x=62 percent. Every character's main strokes remain readable; no whole character is hidden, especially 小. Only a tiny cape flourish may overlap peripheral strokes. She makes ONE decisive diagonal slash with her LEFT hand. The same single blade sweeps through the near foreground with a metal glint, continuous wrist and elbow movement and a secure grip. Her RIGHT hand stays empty. Keep the name stable; no spatial tear or duplicated sword.

5-6 seconds, ordinary speed: Finish the stroke, lower the sword beside her left hip and settle into guard. Stop in a three-quarter view, holding the complete name and pose. H3 generates all lettering natively.

overall_soundscape:
Native audio: courtyard wind, leap rush, one landing, cloth and armor movement, one stretched metal-edged slash whoosh.

non_diegetic_music:
Original dark wuxia percussion, strings and plucked accents suspend beneath the slash, resolving with one decisive beat.
